description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Queue Stream Provider configuration builder in an Orleans project. It verifies different configuration scenarios, such as missing connection strings, minimal configuration, and full configuration, ensuring proper parsing and application of settings.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilderTests
classes.description: Unit test class for Azure Queue Stream Provider configuration builder.

classes.name: TestSiloBuilder
classes.description: A helper class implementing ISiloBuilder for test configuration purposes.

methods.name: Missing_ConnectionString
methods.description: Test to verify behavior when the connection string is missing, expecting null QueueServiceClient.

methods.name: Minimal_Configuration
methods.description: Test to verify that minimal valid configuration creates a valid QueueServiceClient with default settings.

methods.name: Full_Configuration
methods.description: Test to verify that all configuration options are correctly parsed and applied.

methods.name: ConfigureSilo
methods.description: Helper method to configure Silo builder with a given JSON configuration.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Creates an IConfigurationRoot from a JSON string.
